assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq), HISAT2 to Ensembl release-99 rat genome (S4.2.p2-p4)
organism: Rat (male Sprague Dawley, high-fat diet obese model; S4.1.p1)
groups: FC 3, FCE 3, FH 2, FHE 2, MC 3, MCE 3, MH 3, MHE 3 (TAB1, S3.p1, TAB2)
sample_inclusion: 22 samples; two adipose samples excluded for RNA quality (S4.1.p1); FH2 and FHE1 absent (TAB2)
primary_estimand: Effect of 4-week treadmill exercise on gene expression within each tissue, under normoxia (CE vs C) and under hypoxia (HE vs H)
planned_contrasts: Adipose: FCE vs FC (normoxia exercise effect; no DEG count reported)
Adipose: FHE vs FH (hypoxia exercise effect; no DEG count reported)
Muscle: MCE vs MC (normoxia exercise effect; no DEG count reported)
Muscle: MHE vs MH (hypoxia exercise effect; no DEG count reported)
repeated_measure_unit: none within a tissue; muscle and adipose may come from the same rats but pairing is not given
paper_method: DESeq on read counts (ABS.p1); comparisons not enumerated

paper_threshold.source_locator: none (data article: ABS.p1, S3.p1 name DE analysis but give no rule)

paper_results: No DEG counts, gene lists or pathways reported; only correlation heatmap, TPM density and Venn of expressed genes (S3.p2, FIG1-4)
